Shield occupies the central 55% of the disc. Very few broad planes, strong silhouette and ample negative space. No fine scratches, realistic metal, tiny cracks, gradients, multiple arrows, engraved designs, golden decorative details or texture. Keep a solid uniform deep navy-charcoal circular face. Replace the old thin gold rim with a clearly visible COPPER OUTER RIM, warm reddish copper (#b9693e), pale peach copper highlight and dark brown shadow: a simple thick 2-3 tone bevel following the shape of the rarity seal. Copper only on the rim; central symbol ivory/silver with a restrained warm impact accent. The rim occupies about 6% of diameter, complete circle centered within 150x152 production canvas, with about4% transparent padding. Original artwork, match the reference's clean polished flat shading; no copied flame. Legible at24 and32pixels. Genuine alpha transparent outside the round medallion. No text, number, letters, frame, scenery, smoke, glow, wings, watermark or extra symbols. Output ONE icon on a square or near-square canvas suitable for150x152 export.
